body:
这个mod添加了一个与不死图腾相反的东西——必死图腾。你手持它时，只要受到伤害就会立马去世
（据说同时手持不死图腾和必死图腾受到伤害有奇效）

This is a mod with the addition of a strange totem with the name: Must Die Totem. It allows you to die no matter how much damage you take while holding the totem. PLEASE NOTICE: When used, your death site will produce an explosion that does not damage the block but does damage to mobs, so the drops around you will be emptied!!
(It is said that holding both the Totem of Undying and the Must Die Totem at the same time has miraculous effects when taking damage)
